business_problem: Cardinal Group needed to modernize a real-estate data estate, automate reporting across a large portfolio, and turn property data into more proactive operational and client-facing decisions.
solution_summary: Cardinal Group partnered with Searce and Google Cloud to migrate its property-management data environment to BigQuery and layer Gemini-powered automation on top. Searce handled most of the technical migration from PostgreSQL, including syntax rewrites and data-integrity work, which let Cardinal keep delivering business features without downtime. BigQuery now underpins the portfolio analytics environment, automating daily leasing reports and supporting self-service views for clients through Domo. Gemini is being integrated into Cardinal’s Keystone and Domo environments to move the company toward event-driven action and MLOps rather than static reporting. This gave Cardinal a modern data platform for more than 100,000 student beds, freed community staff from manual reporting work, and strengthened partner relationships by letting portfolio managers spend more time on strategic guidance instead of repetitive data requests.
